finalText:
**Migration done.** Switched all 12 remaining `db.query` call sites to `db.execute({ sql, params })`, across `analytics`, `orders`, `billing`, `support`, `catalog`, and `accounts`.

One spot left on `db.query`: `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js`. Left it alone — its header says it's vendored and gets overwritten wholesale on every upgrade, so local edits would just get lost.

Note: `cache.query` calls in several repo files are a different API and weren't touched.
